title: Calling Peaks on piggyBac Calling Card Data
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb9xir7n

steps.title: Compile kmer program
steps.instruction: Compile the provided C++ source file kmer.cc into an executable named kmer.

steps.title: Generate TTAA BED file
steps.instruction: Use the compiled kmer executable to locate every exact TTAA tetramer in the genome FASTA and write the coordinates to a BED file.

steps.title: Filter canonical TTAA sites (optional)
steps.instruction: If desired, keep only TTAA sites on canonical chromosomes (exclude contigs with '_' in their names).

steps.title: Sort CCF files
steps.instruction: Ensure each CCF file is sorted by chromosome, start, and end. Choose any of the three preferred methods.

substeps.instruction: bedtools sort -i sample.ccf > sample_sorted.ccf   # using bedtools
sort -k1V -k2n -k3n sample.ccf > sample_sorted.ccf   # using standard shell sort

steps.title: Create Bayesian blocks from CCF
steps.instruction: Run SegmentCCF.py on the sorted CCF to infer Bayesian blocks and remove any blank lines.

steps.title: Call BRD4 peaks with BBPeakCaller
steps.instruction: Run BBPeakCaller_BRD4.py with the CCF, blocks, TTAA BED, and desired statistical thresholds to produce a BED file of BRD4 peaks.

substeps.instruction: python BBPeakCaller_BRD4.py -p 30 -d 12500 HCT-116_PBase.ccf HCT-116_PBase.blocks hg38_TTAA_canon.bed HCT-116_PBase_peaks.bed
# optional: specify multiple‑hypothesis correction instead of -p, e.g., -a 0.05 -m bonferroni
# optional: write intermediate block‑p‑value table, e.g., -i HCT-116_PBase_intermediate.csv

steps.title: Generate insertion density bedgraph (optional)
steps.instruction: Create a per‑block insertion density track (IPKM) for visualization using CCFIdeogram.py.

steps.title: Create blocks for TF‑directed CCF
steps.instruction: Run SegmentCCF.py on the TF‑directed CCF to obtain Bayesian blocks.

steps.title: Call TF peaks with BBPeakCaller_TF
steps.instruction: Run BBPeakCaller_TF.py with TF‑directed CCF, its blocks, the undirected (control) CCF, and appropriate statistical and filtering flags to obtain TF peaks.

substeps.instruction: python BBPeakCaller_TF.py -a 0.05 -m fdr_bh -d 250 -r -x 5000 HCT-116_SP1-PBase.ccf HCT-116_SP1-PBase.blocks HCT-116_PBase.ccf HCT-116_SP1-PBase_peaks.bed
# alternative: use a p‑value cutoff, e.g., -p 9

steps.title: Perform differential peak calling (optional)
steps.instruction: Use BBPeakCaller_TF.py to compare two datasets, treating one as background, and call peaks enriched in the test condition.

substeps.instruction: python BBPeakCaller_TF.py -p 9 -d 12500 DEX.ccf DEX.blocks DMSO.ccf DEX_peaks.bed   # DEX vs DMSO
python BBPeakCaller_TF.py -p 9 -d 12500 DMSO.ccf DMSO.blocks DEX.ccf DMSO_peaks.bed   # opposite direction
